1.title: Senate Confirms Jay Clayton to Lead U.S. Intelligence Community
1.summary: Mr. Clayton, who shed Democratic support after he refused to clearly say Joseph R. Biden Jr. won the 2020 election, will take over the Office of the Director of National Intelligence from Bill Pulte.

2.title: Trump Asks Supreme Court to Overturn $83.3 Million Award in Carroll Defamation Case
2.summary: President Trump paid E. Jean Carroll more than $5 million from a 2023 lawsuit, but he is now asking the court to overturn a much larger award that a jury ordered him to pay in 2024 for defaming her.

3.title: The Doctor and His Diary: What Fauci’s Innermost Musings Reveal
3.summary: Dr. Anthony S. Fauci seemed to be the life of the party, even in the midst of a deadly pandemic.

4.title: Iran and US trade strikes, shattering brief lull in fighting
4.summary: US Central Command says it intercepted "multiple" ballistic missiles fired by Iran.

5.title: Trump administration bans new Chinese humanoid robots
5.summary: The US and China are locked in a race to the lead the world in robotics and artificial intelligence.

6.title: How Mexican drug cartels have outsourced meth labs to Nigeria
6.summary: West Africa is becoming increasingly attractive to those who want to make and export illicit drugs.
